payload.name: Pet Project Co-Founder AI
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
"Pet Project Co-Founder AI" is your market research assistant.

It will help you validate product ideas using real data from trusted market research services. No more guesses or hallucinations. Instead of relying on plain LLM-only answers, you will use raw market data interpreted by ChatGPT as clear insights.

You do not need prior marketing experience. You just ask a question and the app builds a market research plan for you. The plan will include gathering data from third-party services. You are guided through what services to use and what queries to run there. After you use the recommended service, you copy-paste their data back to the app and get a clear interpretation from ChatGPT.

Examples of questions you can get answers to:
- "I have an idea for the app X. Is there enough demand to justify building it?"
- "What are people searching for when they want Y?"
- "Who exactly is my target user for the app Z? What platforms do they use?"
- "I built an app W. Where do I find users for it?"

For now, the following services are supported:
- SparkToro — audience intelligence (who your users are, what they read, who they follow)
- Ubersuggest — keyword demand and SEO metrics
- AnswerThePublic — real search questions and phrasing

Disclaimers:
- This app does not automatically gather data from the recommended market research services. The app helps with building search queries for these services and reporting the resulting data back. But you will need to visit and use these services yourself. We do not automatically scrape data from these services.
- This app does not provide paid subscriptions to the recommended market research services. You use these services according to their terms of use.
- This app currently supports a limited set of services: SparkToro, Ubersuggest, and AnswerThePublic. Only these services may be recommended during marketing research. Keep in mind that there are other good services for market research on the internet, we just do not support them yet. You can request adding new services by emailing the [developer@petprojectcofounder.ai](mailto:developer@petprojectcofounder.ai)
- For the best experience, it is recommended to use this app on desktop
payload.longDescription:
“宠物项目联合创始人AI”是您的市场研究助理。

它将帮助您通过来自可信市场研究服务的真实数据来验证产品想法. 没有更多的猜测或幻觉. 而不是依靠简单的LLM-只答案,您将使用CATGPT解释的原始市场数据作为清晰的见解。

您不需要之前的营销经验. 您只需要问一个问题,应用程序为您构建了一个市场研究计划。 该计划将包括从第三方服务收集数据。 您将通过使用哪些服务和在那里运行哪些查询进行指导。 使用推荐的服务后,您将其数据复制并粘贴回应用程序,并从ChatGPT获得明确的解释。

您可以得到答案的疑问示例: - “我对应用程序X有一个想法.是否有足够的需求来证明构建它?” - “人们在寻找什么,当他们想要Y?” - “我对应用程序Z的目标用户是谁?他们使用的平台是什么?” - “我建立了一个应用程序W。

目前,支持以下服务: - SparkToro - 观众情报(你的用户是谁,他们读了什么,他们跟随谁) - Ubersuggest - 关键字需求和SEO指标 - AnswerThePublic - 真实的搜索问题和语法

免责声明: - 此应用程序不会自动收集推荐的市场研究服务的数据。 该应用程序有助于构建这些服务的搜索查询并报告结果的数据。 但是您将需要自己访问和使用这些服务。 我们不会自动从这些服务中收集数据。 - 此应用程序不提供推荐的市场研究服务的付费订阅。 您根据他们的使用条款使用这些服务。 - 此应用程序目前支持有限的服务集: SparkToro, Ubersuggest和 AnswerThePublic. 只有这些服务可以在市场研究期间被推荐。 请记住,在互联网上有其他良好的市场研究服务,我们只是没有支持它们。 您可以通过电子邮件(电子邮件:developer@propetcounderfounder.ai)添加新服务 - 为了获得最佳体验,建议您在桌面上

payload.name: Postbeam
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Postbeam connects ChatGPT to your LinkedIn content workflow so you can draft, review, schedule, and analyze posts without leaving the chat. 

Once connected with your Postbeam account, ChatGPT works directly with your real posts, your writing guidance, and your performance data. Turning a chat box into the place you actually run your LinkedIn presence & strategy.

Draft in your voice, from your real work:
Ask ChatGPT to write a post and it pulls in your Postbeam content training, your mission, audience, format rules, and content sources so every draft sounds like you, not generic. Because it's working inside ChatGPT, it can also draw raw material from the other tools you've connected (Slack threads, Gmail, meeting recorders like Fellow or Granola) and turn a real customer calls, shipped features, or team wins into finished posts. Drafts are saved straight into Postbeam for review.

Edit, organize, and manage your queue:
Review your most recent drafts, pull up any single post, and edit its copy or title — all by chatting. You can attach media: images, video, or carousel posts. List posts by status (draft, approved, scheduled) to see exactly where everything stands.

Approve and schedule when you're ready:
When a draft is ready, ChatGPT can approve it and schedule it to publish to your connected LinkedIn at a specific time. Nothing publishes automatically drafts stay drafts until a person decides otherwise, and approving or scheduling respects the permissions on your account.

Understand what's working:
Ask what's performing and get answers from your cached analytics: account-level totals (impressions, reactions, comments, reshares, followers gained, members reached) with a daily trend, plus per-post breakdowns over 30-, 90-, or 365-day windows. Use it to spot your best formats and hooks, then immediately draft your next post in that proven style.

Built for teams and agencies:
Postbeam supports multiple accounts in one place. ChatGPT can list every account you can access, so agencies and teams can switch between clients or teammates and keep each person's drafts, approvals, and analytics cleanly separated.
payload.longDescription:
Postbeam 将 ChatGPT 连接到您的 LinkedIn 内容工作流,这样您就可以在不离开聊天的情况下编写、审查、安排和分析帖子。

一旦连接到你的Postbeam帐户,ChatGPT会直接与你的真实帖子,你的写作指导和你的业绩数据一起工作. 将聊天框变成你实际运行你的LinkedIn存在和策略的地方。

草案在你的声音,从你的真实工作:请 ChatGPT 写一个帖子,它吸引你的 Postbeam 内容培训,你的使命,观众,格式规则和内容来源,所以每个草案听起来像你,而不是通用。

编辑,组织和管理你的队列:审查你最新的草案,提取任何单个帖子,并编辑其副本或标题 - 所有通过聊天。你可以添加媒体:图像,视频或卡鲁塞尔帖子。

当你准备好时批准和安排:当草案准备好时,ChatGPT可以批准它并计划在特定时间发布到你连接的LinkedIn。

了解什么工作: 询问什么工作,并从您的缓存分析中获得答案:帐户级总数(印象,反应,评论,重新分享,追随者获得,会员达到)与每日趋势,加上30天,90天或365天窗口的每条邮件中断。

ChatGPT 可以列出您可以访问的每个帐户,以便机构和团队能够在客户或团队成员之间切换,并保持每个人的草案,批准和分析清晰分开。

payload.name: OriginalVoices
payload.description: 获得任何主题的人类洞察力
payload.summaryOriginal: Get human insight on any topic
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
The human intelligence layer for AI.

OriginalVoices gives ChatGPT instant access to real human perspectives - so you can ground decisions and AI outputs in what your target audience actually thinks, feels, and values.

Instead of guessing or relying on assumptions, get authentic feedback from real people directly inside ChatGPT. Share ideas, test messaging, validate concepts, or explore what matters to any audience - and use those insights to understand your audience, inform better decisions and create more targeted AI outputs.

With OriginalVoices, you can:
- Define any target audience
- Share anything - questions, links, copy, product concepts, campaign ideas
